title: Why Is Lionel Messi Called the Greatest of All Time?
description:
Eight Ballons d'Or. A record 474 La Liga goals. Seventy-three goals in one season. Two trebles. The 2022 World Cup. In a limited sample of StatsBomb event data (12 Barcelona league starts in 2009/10 and 12 in 2018/19), his key passes per 90 minutes rose from 1.4 to 3.5. Career facts and season-by-season goals from Wikipedia; photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in the video. Shirts are original artwork without club crests or sponsors.
